sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your prompt response and your interest in a 24-month contract. Our traditional foundry takes great pride in the long-standing relationships we share with our partners in the region. 

Our offer stands at a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. To move forward, we can offer €51.80 and extend the payment terms to 45 days, which we believe is a fair compromise. Alternatively, with a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

As your price offer remained unchanged, we are only able to make a minimal adjustment to €51.70 per unit. Our present proposal is a price of €51.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This quote remains valid for 30 days. Alternatively, with valid from 1 February 2027: a price of €51.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. We now expect a meaningful step towards our position to continue our trustful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

This Angebot stays valid for 7 days. We expect a meaningful step towards our position to continue our trustful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
